# Establishments in the simulation: Reports to EDDC = Y (official List, May 2026)

<!-- Generated by tools/build_establishments_doc.mjs. Edit the generator, not this file. -->

**84 establishment codes, 83 sites.** The simulation's reporting sites are *exactly* the establishments with **Reports to EDDC = Y** in the WA Health *Establishment List*, May 2026 (v0.1), as supplied to this project by its user. Peel Health Campus appears under two codes (0145 and 0645), so 84 codes cover 83 sites, of which 1 (WA Virtual Hospital, 0123) is a virtual emergency department with no physical ED. Sources are in [SOURCES.md](SOURCES.md).

## How the list was read and checked

* `tools/extract_establishment_list.py` reads the List's "Establishment List, Reporting" table (191 rows) **twice, independently**: once from `pdftotext -layout` (each Y goes to the nearest column header) and once from `pdftotext -bbox` (each Y's x-position is compared with the EDDC and HMDC header positions). The two reads must agree or the script stops. Both give **84 rows with EDDC = Y**.
* Applied to the NADC column, the same method gives 125, the count the sister project OutpatientFlow-WA uses.
* Cross-check against SLIP (Landgate HEALTH-001, which has its own "ED" flag): 83 SLIP sites are flagged ED. Codes in the List but not flagged ED in SLIP: 0123 WA Virtual Hospital; 4058 Jurien Bay Hospital. SLIP sites flagged ED but **not** in the List's EDDC set: 102 Fremantle Hospital and Health Service; 266 Wickham Health Centre (see [OPEN-QUESTIONS.md](OPEN-QUESTIONS.md)).
* The other collections these sites also report to (from the same table): HMDC 79, NADC 82, ESWLDC 29, MHDC 16, SANADC 17.

## What is official and what is not

| Field | Where it comes from | Official? |
|---|---|---|
| **Code**, **Name**, **Reports to EDDC = Y** | Establishment List May 2026, "Establishment List, Reporting" table | **Yes** |
| **Type** (AH, NP, OH) and **MPS** flag | Same document: Hospital Morbidity System Codes table (Est type) and Multi-Purpose Services appendix | **Yes** (83 of 84; 1 code has no Est type) |
| **HSP** (Health Service Provider) | **Not in the List.** SLIP HEALTH-001 geographic service, with overrides noted below | **No** |
| **Region, district, beds, suburb** | **Not in the List.** SLIP HEALTH-001 / HEALTH-002 | **No** |
| **Latitude / longitude** | **Not in the List.** SLIP HEALTH-001, or OpenStreetMap where SLIP does not have the site | **No** |
| **Model tier** (teaching, regional, nursing post ...) | This project, from the SLIP category. Sets synthetic volumes only | **No** |

Where an official name differs from the SLIP name, the **official name is used**; the SLIP name is kept as `slipName`.

## Sites needing a note

* **0107 Perth Children's Hospital** (CAHS, basis `crs`): Perth Children's Hospital is part of CAHS (SLIP lists it under the North Metro geographic service).
* **0123 WA Virtual Hospital** (WACHS, basis `agreement`): WAVED is described in the WACHS 2025-26 Service Agreement (s 3.1.1), with its functions performed by the Department CEO through the State Health Operations Centre (SHOC) during a transfer period. Shown under WACHS as a display grouping only.
* **0145 Peel Health Campus** (SMHS, basis `crs`): Peel Health Campus returned to public operation (SMHS) on 13 Aug 2024. The Establishment List has Peel under both 0145 and 0645 with Reports to EDDC = Y; SLIP uses 645.
* **0642 Joondalup Health Campus** (NMHS, basis `crs`): Joondalup Health Campus: public services operated by Ramsay Health Care under a public-private arrangement; NMHS catchment.
* **0645 Peel Health Campus** (SMHS, basis `slip`): Second Peel Health Campus code. In the List 0645 reports to EDDC, MHDC and SANADC only, and is not in the Hospital Morbidity System Codes table. Assumed to be the same physical site as 0145 (not verified).
* **4058 Jurien Bay Hospital** (WACHS, basis `assumed`): HSP not stated in the documents; Jurien Bay is in a WA Country Health Service area; display grouping.
* **6007 St John of God Midland Health Campus** (EMHS, basis `crs`): St John of God Midland Public Hospital: operated by St John of God Health Care under a public-private arrangement; EMHS catchment. Uses Midland webPAS (EDDC Data Dictionary, abbreviations SJOGM).

### Positions not taken directly from SLIP (3; ⚑ in the app where approximate)

* **0123 WA Virtual Hospital** (`virtual`): WA Virtual Hospital: a virtual service (WA Virtual Emergency Department, WAVED) with no physical emergency department. Not in SLIP. Shown at a placeholder point in the Perth CBD.
* **0145 Peel Health Campus** (`slip-other-id`): SLIP lists this site as estab_id 645 "Peel Health Campus".
* **4058 Jurien Bay Hospital** (`osm-similar-name`): Not in SLIP. OpenStreetMap has "Jurien Bay Health Centre", 23 Whitfield Road, Jurien Bay, but no "Jurien Bay Hospital"; assumed to be the same site (not verified). District and region by point-in-polygon on the SLIP HEALTH-002 boundaries.

Position status overall: slip 81, virtual 1, slip-other-id 1, osm-similar-name 1.

### HSP not taken from SLIP (6; marked * below)

0107 PCH (CAHS, crs); 0123 WAVED (WACHS, agreement); 0145 Peel (SMHS, crs); 0642 Joondalup (NMHS, crs); 4058 Jurien Bay (WACHS, assumed); 6007 SJOG Midland (EMHS, crs). `crs` = Department of Health Central Referral Service page; `agreement` = WACHS Service Agreement 2025-26; `assumed` = display grouping only, because the documents do not say.

## Known gaps

* **No HSP, region or coordinates in the official List.** All three are this project's joins (SLIP HEALTH-001/-002, OpenStreetMap, the Central Referral Service page, the WACHS Service Agreement). The data custodian can replace them.
* **Peel Health Campus has two codes** (0145 and 0645) with EDDC = Y. 0645 is not in the Hospital Morbidity System Codes table and has no Est type. The app treats 0645 as the same site with no activity of its own (open question).
* **WA Virtual Hospital (0123)** has no physical ED. It is drawn at a placeholder point in the Perth CBD and grouped under WACHS for display only (open questions).
* SLIP flags Fremantle Hospital and Health Service and Wickham Health Centre as ED sites, but neither is in the List's EDDC set.
